title: 51:13 stretched forth the heavens/laid the foundations of the earth. In Genesis we read of God's creative powers, "In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth" (Gen. 1:1), dividing the light from the darkness. He laid the foundations of earth by causing dry land to appear and by bringing forth plants on the land (Gen. 1:9, 11-12). The God of creation would certainly also have power to fulfill his promises of deliverance and blessing to Zion.
author: Tina M. Peterson
